Test question 20: Explain a concept relevant to AI safety.

AI safety involves ensuring that artificial intelligence systems behave as intended and do not cause unintended harm. Key areas include alignment (ensuring AI goals match human values), robustness (performing well in unexpected situations), and interpretability (understanding why AI makes specific decisions).
